# Table
```{r table, out.width="100%"}
dfs <- list(
  "graph" = graph,
  "graph-light" = graph_light,
  "linear" = linear,
  "linear-light" = linear_light,
  #"constrained" = constrained
)

scores <- c("Individual", "Ensemble")

# "median (q1, q3)"
fmt_mqq <- function(m, q1, q3, digits) {
  sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f (%.", digits, "f, %.", digits, "f)"), m, q1, q3)
}

# One data frame -> one row per task_id, with Individual and Ensemble columns
make_cols <- function(df, col_name, digits = 3) {
  q <- function(x, p) quantile(x, p, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE)

  df %>%
    group_by(task_id) %>%
    summarise(
      ind_med = median(individual_tpot, na.rm = TRUE),
      ind_q1  = q(individual_tpot, 0.25),
      ind_q3  = q(individual_tpot, 0.75),
      ens_med = median(ensemble_random_100, na.rm = TRUE),
      ens_q1  = q(ensemble_random_100, 0.25),
      ens_q3  = q(ensemble_random_100, 0.75),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      !!paste0(col_name, "|Individual") := fmt_mqq(ind_med, ind_q1, ind_q3, digits),
      !!paste0(col_name, "|Ensemble")   := fmt_mqq(ens_med, ens_q1, ens_q3, digits)
    ) %>%
    select(task_id, all_of(paste0(col_name, "|", scores)))
}

cols     <- imap(dfs, ~ make_cols(.x, .y))
combined <- reduce(cols, full_join, by = "task_id")

combined_df <- as.data.frame(combined, check.names = FALSE)

print(combined_df)
```

```{r export, out.width="100%"}
n_methods <- length(dfs)

# "c|cc|cc|cc|cc|cc": a line after id and after each method's Individual/Ensemble pair
align_str <- paste0("c|", paste(rep("cc", n_methods), collapse = "|"))

tex <- kable(combined_df,
             format = "latex",
             booktabs = TRUE,
             align = align_str,
             col.names = c("id", rep(scores, n_methods)),
             row.names = FALSE,
             linesep = "",
             caption = "Median (Q1, Q3) of individual and ensemble score per task.",
             label = "tpot-results",
             table.envir = "table",
             position = "H",
             escape = TRUE) %>%
  add_header_above(setNames(c(1, rep(length(scores), n_methods)),
                            c(" ", names(dfs))))

tex <- gsub("\\begin{tabular}", "\\resizebox{\\linewidth}{!}{\\begin{tabular}", tex, fixed = TRUE)
tex <- gsub("\\end{tabular}",   "\\end{tabular}}",                             tex, fixed = TRUE)
tex <- gsub("\\centering",
            "\\centering\\renewcommand{\\arraystretch}{1.25}\\setlength{\\tabcolsep}{4pt}",
            tex, fixed = TRUE)

writeLines(tex, "results_table.tex")
```
